description: The Chief Minister Divyangjan Empowerment Scheme (Sambal) is an initiative of the Government of Bihar to ensure the welfare and empowerment of persons with disabilities. The scheme aims to provide timely access to disability-related welfare schemes, promote awareness about the rights of persons with disabilities, and support their physical, social, educational, and economic empowerment. The scheme is fully funded by the State Government and also provides supplementary financial assistance for beneficiaries covered under National Trust schemes.
objectives: Provide timely benefits under disability welfare schemes.
Promote awareness about the rights of persons with disabilities.
Empower persons with disabilities physically, socially, educationally, and economically.
Provide financial support for self-employment, education, and rehabilitation.
Support beneficiaries covered under National Trust schemes through state-funded assistance.

benefits.title: Self-Employment Loan
benefits.description: Financial assistance in the form of a loan of up to ₹2,00,000 for self-employment.

benefits.title: Scholarship Support
benefits.description: Scholarships are provided for students studying in special schools at rates applicable under the scheme.

benefits.title: National Trust Assistance
benefits.description: State grant is provided for eligible beneficiaries under National Trust schemes based on scheme requirements.

benefits.title: Special Financial Assistance
benefits.description: Special grants may be provided in exceptional cases involving multiple disabilities or as per specific beneficiary needs.

eligibility.title: Self-Employment Loan
eligibility.description: Applicants should be between 18 and 60 years of age.

eligibility.title: Artificial Limbs and Equipment
eligibility.description: Applicants should be more than 5 years of age.

eligibility.title: Special School
eligibility.description: Students should be between 6 and 18 years of age.

eligibility.title: Shelter Home
eligibility.description: Applicants for Ashiyana/Saket shelter homes must be at least 18 years old.

eligibility.title: Special Cases
eligibility.description: In exceptional cases involving multiple disabilities or court judgments, there will be no restriction on age or income.

registration_steps.title: Visit Official Website
registration_steps.description: Visit the official portal for the scheme.

registration_steps.title: Register
registration_steps.description: Complete the mandatory online registration process.

registration_steps.title: Login
registration_steps.description: Log in using the registered credentials.

application_steps.title: Fill Application Form
application_steps.description: Complete the online application form with personal details.

application_steps.title: Upload Photograph and Signature
application_steps.description: Upload the applicant's recent photograph and signature.

application_steps.title: Upload Documents
application_steps.description: Upload all the required supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Submit Application
application_steps.description: Review the application and submit it online.

documents_required.name: Mobile Number Linked with Aadhaar
documents_required.remarks: The mobile number should be registered with Aadhaar.

important_notes: The scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.
Financial assistance under National Trust schemes is provided as per beneficiary requirements.
Special provisions are available for applicants with multiple disabilities.
Online registration is mandatory before submitting the application.

faqs.question: What is the maximum self-employment loan available?
faqs.answer: Eligible beneficiaries can receive a loan of up to ₹2,00,000.

faqs.question: Who can apply for self-employment assistance?
faqs.answer: Persons with disabilities between 18 and 60 years of age can apply.

faqs.question: Is there any age limit for artificial limbs and assistive devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. The applicant should be more than 5 years of age.

faqs.question: Is online registration mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Applicants must register online before filling out the application form.

faqs.question: Does the scheme provide support under National Trust schemes?
faqs.answer: Yes. The State Government provides supplementary financial assistance for eligible National Trust beneficiaries.
